Email Patch Diff

  • CURIE: gmeow:EmailPatchDiff
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EmailPatchDiff
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/email

A patch or diff artifact between email body or header states, typically between a variant message and its canonical counterpart. Treated as a MIME-like BodyPart so it can carry mediaType, contentDigest, and derivation links.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:BodyPart

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:EmailPatchDiff as a specialized kind of gmeow:BodyPart. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:BodyPart
